general.title: Next scheduled council election
general.dateBasis: Calendar calculation from the rule published by ECQ, not an issued notice of election. This indicative date does not activate a countdown.

earlyVoting.status: No Redland 2028 early-voting timetable verified in this first pass. Dates, eligibility, opening hours and locations will be linked when ECQ publishes the election details.

byElection.dateBasis: No Redland polling date or time was listed on the ECQ election-events page checked 1 November 2026, Australia/Brisbane. Council has agreed to request a full postal ballot, subject to electoral approval processes; this is not a confirmed voting method or timetable. No date is estimated.
byElection.status: Mayoral office vacant; by-election required. Council has agreed to request a full postal ballot, subject to approval. ECQ polling and nomination timetable awaiting confirmation.

nominationDeadline.dateBasis: Await the event-specific ECQ nomination day and deadline. No nomination date has been inferred.

sources.title: Council confirms mayoral vacancy following resignation
sources.publisher: Redland City Council / Redlands Coast Today
sources.supports: Resignation received, vacancy, by-election required, Julie Talty continuing as Acting Mayor.

sources.title: Council to seek full postal vote for Mayoral by-election
sources.publisher: Redland City Council / Redlands Coast Today
sources.supports: Council agreed to request an ECQ recommendation for a full postal ballot, subject to electoral requirements and approvals. No voting method or timetable approval is announced.

sources.title: ECQ election events
sources.supports: No Redland event timetable listed at this check; 2024 local elections held 16 March 2024.

sources.title: Local Government Act 2009, sections 161, 164 and 165
sources.supports: Mayor replacement and acting arrangements; final part begins at third anniversary of previous quadrennial election.

sources.title: Local Government Electoral Act 2011, sections 24, 25 and 27
sources.supports: Ordinary by-election timing, notice and nomination/poll intervals; nominations before noon. This is not an issued election timetable.

sources.title: ECQ local government candidate guidance
sources.supports: Eligibility, training, nomination and campaign obligations; guidance does not announce Redland nominations.

sources.title: Rowanne McKenzie: public intention to nominate for Mayor
sources.publisher: Cr Rowanne McKenzie, public Facebook page
sources.supports: Public decision to nominate for Mayor, not ECQ acceptance.
sources.method: Public cloud-browser post and expanded text; displayed 7 hours ago at 11:20 UTC on 1 November (21:20 AEST), establishing the local calendar date without inventing a precise posting time.

sources.title: Council Division 7 newsletter: official Facebook handle

postalVotingProposal.summary: On 29 October, Council agreed to ask ECQ to recommend a full postal ballot to the Minister for Local Government. This is a request subject to electoral requirements and approval processes, not a confirmed voting method or election timetable.

candidates.name: Rowanne McKenzie
candidates.summary: Announced her decision to nominate for Mayor of Redland City. This is a public intention to run, not an ECQ-accepted nomination.

byElection.candidateCoverage: One primary-source announcement verified in this focused review; not a complete field or an official ballot. ECQ had not published a Redland nomination timetable on its election-events page at the 1 November 2026 check.

refreshTriggers: Official vacancy notice or ECQ election notice
ECQ early-voting or postal-voting timetable published or changed
Primary-source public candidate intention or announcement; keep separate from ECQ-accepted nominations
New candidate acceptance, withdrawal or declaration
Election day reached; verify status and results
reviewScope: 1 November 2026 Australia/Brisbane focused review: Rowanne McKenzie public intention to nominate, authenticated primary Facebook page, Council postal-request notice and ECQ event list. No accepted nomination or election timetable verified. Other source checks and historical records retain their earlier dates.
